feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
A smaller, more actively engaged group of editors is preferable for managing the BIPs repository. Limiting the team to three dedicated members appears to be a reasonable approach, as it fosters effective collaboration and accountability among those involved.
Recognition is given to the editors, with particular appreciation for Murch's contributions. The efforts devoted over the past two years have significantly revitalized the BIPs repository, encompassing both visible achievements and behind-the-scenes work. These contributions have played a crucial role in enhancing the project's organization and progress.
